headline: Citigroup Maintains Neutral on EPAM Systems, Lowers Price Target to $100
summary: Citigroup  analyst Bryan Keane   maintains EPAM Systems (NYSE:EPAM) with a Neutral and lowers the price target from $112 to $100.
